tools.name: bdk_whoami
tools.description: Read the signed-in user and their projects, with the project codes the other tools take. product_selected can be an unconfirmed default. Legacy status is not ledger entitlement; bdk_next.commerce has the entitlement.

tools.name: bdk_projects
tools.description: List projects or read a status/progress/health snapshot, not full settings or credentials. Use bdk_next.commerce for ledger entitlement and current requests. Do not infer payment or delivery from legacy status, paid_for_service, requested_build, build_complete, rebuild_credits or free_rebuild_expire

tools.name: bdk_next
tools.description: Read workflow state and next steps; call again after each action. confirm_product writes and records the customer-confirmed iOS / Android / Both choice: ask first. Checkout requires recorded confirmation matching the saved platform, even when the saved default already matches the customer's choice.

tools.name: bdk_create_project
tools.description: Create a project after approval of the reference label and published app URL. project_name is a reference label, not the home-screen app name; that starts as the website hostname until configured. tools.name: bdk_build
tools.description: Request a build or rebuild only after explicit approval of that request and the saved settings. A first build requires confirm_build:true after the customer says yes. A ledger rebuild consumes one banked rebuild: pass build_kind:rebuild and confirm_consumes_rebuild:true. free_rebuild is legacy-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_estimate, bdk_checkout, bdk_build · Private data: bdk_projects, bdk_next, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check, bdk_build · Public sink: bdk_next, bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Destructive: bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_estimate, bdk_checkout, bdk_build · Private data: bdk_projects, bdk_next, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check, bdk_build · Public sink: bdk_next, bdk_create_project, bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_build · Destructive: bdk_configure, bdk_upload, bdk_setup_preview, bdk_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
